segments.he: בְּעֶשְׂרִים וְתִשְׁעָה בֶּאֱלוּל — רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר וְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן לְטַעְמַיְיהוּ, דְּאָמְרִי: בְּאֶחָד בְּתִשְׁרִי רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה לְמַעְשַׂר בְּהֵמָה.
segments.en: Finally, they hold that the third time for animal tithe is «on the twenty-ninth of Elul,» since «Rabbi Elazar and Rabbi Shimon» conform «to their» standard line of «reasoning, as they say: On the first of Tishrei» is the «new year for animal tithe.» All animals born prior to that date belong to the previous year for tithe and are tithed as a single unit, whereas those born after that date belong to the next year for tithe, and therefore there is a distinction drawn between the new animals and the old.
